source.notes: Revit's own IFC4 exports of this file (2026-11-03, kept local, not in the repo) give the known rows below; the rest stay decoder baselines or unknowns. Curtain wall 7187 holds 24 loadable 'Family1' panels (1000 x 2000 mm frames, 250 mm deep, 0.14 m3) and no mullion; Wall 2808 hosts the 2 windows.

levels.source: Revit 2023.1 (23.1.90.15) default IFC4RV and IFC4DTV exports, 2026-11-03 (local only; RV sha256 b461e080451406124a06234d7f9e89db1b8ce103ce51fb2db73e5c77c7160cee, DTV sha256 c596a4674b7091904d438fc844c06d9f5166e27287a0118df66b59136909eb70); both agree: one IfcBuildingStorey, Level 1
levels.notes: Einhoven's Level records do not decode, so its storeys come from the base elevations of its ArcWall records, which are the curtain panels' (Level 1 plus one per panel row, named Elevation 6.562 ft, 13.123 ft and Roof).
